_comment: SKYWEE deployed contract hashes on Casper Testnet (protocol 2.2.2). VERIFIED — all 5 contracts successfully deployed and registered on-chain.
_rpc_url_note: Use via cspr-auth-proxy.py on 127.0.0.1:7778 (CSPR.cloud requires Bearer auth, casper-client CLI has no --header flag)

_cost_summary.note: Burned includes retries from OOG (Out Of Gas) errors on Insurance/Treasury/RwaVault which needed 2-3 attempts each before finding correct payment amount.

_deployment_notes: All 5 SKYWEE contracts are LIVE on Casper testnet.
Gas consumption per contract (verified via cspr.live):
AgentRegistry:     153 CSPR  (200 CSPR limit — passed first try)
InsuranceContract: 213 CSPR  (500 CSPR limit — failed first at 200 CSPR)
TreasuryContract:  233 CSPR  (500 CSPR limit — failed first at 200 CSPR)
RwaVault:          176 CSPR  (500 CSPR limit — failed first 2 attempts)
CarbonGuard:       163 CSPR  (500 CSPR limit — passed first try at 500)
Recommended payment for future deploys: 500_000_000_000 motes (500 CSPR)
per contract — gives ~2x headroom above highest observed cost (Treasury).
Gotchas encountered during deploy:
1. Odra init() requires 4 'odra_cfg_*' runtime args even for contracts
with init() that takes no user args. Without these, init() reverts
with 'User error: 64658' = OdraError::MissingArg.
See: scripts/deploy-casper-client.sh (auto-injects these args).
2. CannotOverrideKeys (User error: 64641) happens when a previous
deploy failed OOG but still lodged the package_hash named key in
account state. Retry with odra_cfg_allow_key_override=true to
bypass. Once successful, subsequent deploys need allow_key_override
=true too (the key already exists from the failed attempt).
3. Casper 2.x wraps deploy execution results in Version2 envelope
(different JSON shape than 1.x). scripts/deploy-casper-client.sh
handles both shapes in wait_and_extract_hash().

agent_registry.init_args: odra_cfg_* (package_hash_key_name=agent_registry_package_hash, allow_key_override=false → true on retry, is_upgradable=true, is_upgrade=false)

treasury.note: Highest gas consumer — init() writes auto_execute_threshold as additional storage entry.

rwa_vault.second_attempt_error: User error: 64641 (CannotOverrideKeys — previous failed deploy lodged the key)
